sentence: There were hundreds of guests, all dressed up in formal, colourful clothes.
translation: 到场宾客数以百计，个个盛装打扮，身着正式而鲜艳的礼服。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：all dressed up in... 为独立主格结构作伴随状语——逻辑主语 all（= all the guests）与过去分词 dressed 构成逻辑上的主谓（被动）关系 | 独立主格 = 名词/代词 + 分词/形容词/介词短语等，前后无连词，逗号相连（课堂例句：The teacher came in, a book under his arm. / Her glasses broken, she couldn't see...）| dress up 盛装打扮（dress up as 装扮成）| formal, colourful 双形容词并列（逗号隔开不用 and）| there be + 数量 + 主格补充：先给全景再推特写的描写笔法
pattern: There were + N, all + V-ed + in ...（独立主格）
imitationCn: 台下坐着上千名观众，人人都挥舞着手中的荧光棒。
imitationHint: There were thousands of spectators, → all waving the glow sticks in their hands（独立主格：all + 现在分词表主动）
imitationAnswer: There were thousands of spectators, all waving the glow sticks in their hands.

sentence: I did not understand all of the traditional customs, but a few made a deep impression on me.
translation: 不是所有的传统习俗我都了解，但有一些给我留下了深刻的印象。
analysis: not... all 部分否定：“并非全部”（≠ 全不懂；全否定用 none/not any）——语法与翻译的双重考点 | but 转折后 a few 与 all 呼应：从“不全懂”到“个别深刻”，跨文化叙事的诚实视角 | make/leave a deep impression on sb 给某人留下深刻印象（课堂 impression 网络：give sb the impression of、be under the impression that 以为、impress sb with sth）| custom 多义辨析：习俗（本句）/ customs 海关 / customer 顾客
pattern: S + did not + V + all of ..., but a few + made a deep impression on + sb
imitationCn: 不是每道当地菜我都吃得惯，但有几道让我念念不忘。
imitationHint: I did not get used to all of the local dishes（部分否定）→ but a few made a deep impression on me
imitationAnswer: I did not get used to all of the local dishes, but a few made a deep impression on me.

sentence: The customs that followed were anything but ordinary.
translation: 接下来的习俗绝非寻常。
analysis: anything but 绝不、根本不（= not at all / definitely not）——字面“除了……什么都是”，即完全否定 ordinary | 课堂三兄弟辨析（高考高频）：anything but 绝不 / nothing but 仅仅、只不过（= only）/ all but 几乎（= almost）——The hotel was anything but satisfactory. 旅馆根本不令人满意 | that followed 定语从句（that 作主语不可省），follow 不及物“随后发生” | 短句设悬：说“绝不寻常”却不说是什么——引读者继续读下去的叙事钩子
pattern: The N + that followed + were anything but + adj.
imitationCn: 接下来的表演绝非普通。
imitationHint: The performance that followed → was anything but ordinary（anything but = 绝不）
imitationAnswer: The performance that followed was anything but ordinary.

sentence: I could see a group of around 20 Brazilian dancers and a band in fancy costumes standing in the street.
translation: 我看到大约二十名巴西舞者和一支穿着华丽演出服的乐队站在街上。
analysis: see + 宾语 + doing（standing）：感官动词的“主谓宾+宾补”结构，现在分词表正在进行的状态 | 宾语是并列双名词组 a group of around 20 Brazilian dancers and a band，around 约（≈ about）| in fancy costumes 介词短语作后置定语修饰乐队装扮（costume 演出服、戏装，区别于日常 clothes）| 感官动词宾补三态（课堂重点）：see sb doing 正在做 / see sb do 做过全过程 / see sth done 被做——本单元稍后 notice five hours fly by 正是省 to 不定式版，两句对照记忆
pattern: S + could see + N₁ and N₂ + in + N + V-ing + 地点
imitationCn: 我看到十几个身着传统服饰的孩子在广场上跳舞。
imitationHint: I could see a dozen children in traditional costumes → dancing in the square（see sb doing）
imitationAnswer: I could see a dozen children in traditional costumes dancing in the square.

sentence: I was so caught up in the party fever that I hardly noticed five hours fly by!
translation: 我完全沉浸在派对的狂热里，几乎没察觉五个小时飞逝而过！
analysis: so + adj. + that 结果状语从句 | be/get caught up in 深深卷入、沉浸于（= be absorbed in；课堂辨析：be caught in a storm 遭遇暴雨）| 从句内 noticed five hours fly by：感官动词 notice + 宾语 + 省 to 不定式——表“全过程”（五个小时完整飞过去了都没察觉），课件专门让学生在课文里找的句子，与 see... standing（进行中）构成宾补两态对照 | hardly 半否定：几乎没有 | fly by 时间飞逝（拟物）| 感叹号收束情绪——记叙文高潮句
pattern: S + was so caught up in + N + that + S + hardly noticed + N + V原形
imitationCn: 我完全沉浸在这本小说里，几乎没察觉一个下午悄悄溜走！
imitationHint: I was so caught up in the novel that → I hardly noticed a whole afternoon slip away（notice + 宾 + 动词原形）
imitationAnswer: I was so caught up in the novel that I hardly noticed a whole afternoon slip away!

sentence: Luo Yan's son, Bofeng, happily takes a bite of the chicken his grandfather has selected for him.
translation: 罗言的儿子博峰美滋滋地咬了一口爷爷为他挑选的鸡肉。
analysis: Luo Yan's son, Bofeng：同位语（先关系后人名，逗号包夹）| take a bite of 咬一口（bite 名词“咬下的一口”；动词变位 bite-bit-bitten）| the chicken (that) his grandfather has selected for him：省略 that 的定语从句，从句用现在完成时——“刚刚夹好的”那口鸡肉，时态里藏着长辈的动作先行 | select 课堂辨析（choose/select/elect/pick）：select 强调精心挑选，爷爷“选”的不是鸡肉是疼爱 | 一般现在时叙事（历史现在时）让团圆饭的画面就在眼前 | 全句是“以小见大”细节描写的典范：一口鸡肉写尽三代亲情
pattern: N's son, 同位语, + adv. + takes a bite of + the N (that) + S + has + V-ed + for him
imitationCn: 李奶奶的孙女小雨开心地尝了一口奶奶特意为她留的月饼。
imitationHint: Grandma Li's granddaughter, Xiaoyu, happily takes a bite of the mooncake → (that) her grandma has saved specially for her
imitationAnswer: Grandma Li's granddaughter, Xiaoyu, happily takes a bite of the mooncake her grandma has saved specially for her.

sentence: Indeed, the whole family could not be happier to be together.
translation: 的确，一家人再没有比团团圆圆更高兴的事了。
analysis: 课件专项句型：否定词 + 比较级 = 最高级——could not be happier 字面“不可能更高兴”，实义“高兴到了极点”（= the happiest）；同族：I've never seen a nicer painting than this one. / Nothing is more important than health. | could 虚拟色彩：设想中也不可能更高兴 | to be together 不定式作原因状语（因团聚而乐）| Indeed 强调副词开头，肯定并加深上文 | 这一“正话反说”句式是书面表达升级利器：It couldn't be better. 再好不过了
pattern: S + could not be + 比较级 + to V（否定+比较级=最高级）
imitationCn: 说真的，同学们对这次春游再满意不过了。
imitationHint: Indeed, the students could not be more satisfied → with the spring outing（否定+比较级）
imitationAnswer: Indeed, the students could not be more satisfied with the spring outing.

sentence: However, the high-speed train has made it much more convenient for them to go back home.
translation: 然而，高铁使他们回家变得方便多了。
analysis: 课件专项句型：it 作形式宾语——make + it + 宾补（much more convenient）+ 真宾语（for them to go back home 不定式复合结构）；think/feel/find/consider 同用此结构：I think it important for us to exercise every day. | much 修饰比较级 more convenient | convenient 用法铁律（课堂强调）：作表语不能用人作主语——说 It is convenient for sb to do，不说 sb is convenient | 现在完成时 has made：高铁带来的改变延续至今 | However 承接上文“离家乡很远”，一句话完成“远→近”的转折
pattern: S + has made + it + much more + adj. + for sb + to V
imitationCn: 然而，网上预约使老人们看病变得容易多了。
imitationHint: However, online booking has made it much easier → for the elderly to see a doctor（it 形式宾语 + for sb to do）
imitationAnswer: However, online booking has made it much easier for the elderly to see a doctor.

sentence: During the five-hour trip, they chatted excitedly with each other, their minds full of thoughts about their sweet home.
translation: 在五个小时的旅程中，他们兴奋地聊着天，心里满是对温暖的家的思念。
analysis: 句末 their minds full of thoughts... 为独立主格结构：逻辑主语 their minds + 形容词短语 full of...（= and their minds were full of...）——名词+形容词型独立主格，与本单元 Reading 的 all dressed up（名词+过去分词型）互为姊妹例（课堂同型：He entered the house, his nose red with cold.）| the five-hour trip 复合形容词作定语：数词-名词单数（five-hour 不加 s）| chatted excitedly with each other 副词修饰+相互代词 | 外动作（聊天）与内心理（思家）双线并写——记叙文“动作+心理”的镜头语言
pattern: During + N, S + V-ed ..., their + N + adj.短语（独立主格）
imitationCn: 在两个小时的候机中，她安静地翻着相册，眼里满是对旧时光的怀念。
imitationHint: During the two-hour wait, she quietly looked through the album, → her eyes full of longing for the old days（独立主格）
imitationAnswer: During the two-hour wait, she quietly looked through the album, her eyes full of longing for the old days.

sentence: From the neat designs of the paper-cuttings on the windows, to the Spring Festival couplets on the door, and to the New Year paintings on the wall, everything represents joy, luck and happiness.
translation: 从窗上贴得整整齐齐的剪纸，到门上的春联，再到墙上的年画，无不象征着欢乐、吉祥和幸福。
analysis: From... to... and to... 三段式排比铺陈：三个介词短语层层推进（窗→门→墙），空间移步换景，最后 everything 一词总收——“分述+总括”的圆形结构 | 每个节点都带 on 短语精确定位（on the windows/door/wall）| represents 象征、代表（= symbolizes；课堂 represent 多义：代表某人 / 意味着 / 描绘成 represent... as）| joy, luck and happiness 三名词并列与前文三景呼应，双三排比对称 | 春节意象词汇包：paper-cuttings 剪纸、Spring Festival couplets 春联、New Year paintings 年画——文化作文必备
pattern: From + N₁, to + N₂, and to + N₃, everything + represents + A, B and C
imitationCn: 从桌上的青花瓷茶具，到墙角的兰花，再到窗边的书法条幅，处处透着主人的雅致品味。
imitationHint: From the blue-and-white tea set on the table, to the orchid in the corner, and to the calligraphy scroll by the window, → everything reflects the host's refined taste
imitationAnswer: From the blue-and-white tea set on the table, to the orchid in the corner, and to the calligraphy scroll by the window, everything reflects the host's refined taste.

sentence: May you get more than you wish for every year.
translation: 愿你年年得到的都比所愿的更多（年年有余）。
analysis: 课件专项句型：may 表祝愿的倒装句——May + 主语 + 动词原形，may 提到句首（正常语序 You may get... 不表祝愿）；课堂套句：May you be happy! / May our friendship last forever! / May we never forget each other. | more than you wish for：比较结构嵌套省略 that 的定语从句（you wish for 修饰隐含的 what/things），wish for 许愿盼望（介词 for 不可丢）| 这正是“年年有余”的英译巧思：不译鱼，译“所得超所愿” | 节日祝福、毕业赠言、书信结尾的万能句式
pattern: May + S + V原形 + more than + S + wish for（祝愿倒装）
imitationCn: 愿你收获的永远比付出的更多，愿我们的友谊地久天长。
imitationHint: May you always gain more than you give, → and may our friendship last forever（两个 May 倒装并列）
imitationAnswer: May you always gain more than you give, and may our friendship last forever.

sentence: They gather around the television to watch the Spring Festival Gala, while eating snacks, chatting with each other and making dumplings that they will eat at the very start of the new year.
translation: 他们围坐在电视机前看春节联欢晚会，一边吃着零食、聊着天，一边包着新年伊始要吃的饺子。
analysis: 课件专项：while eating... 为状语从句的省略——从句主语与主句一致且谓语含 be 时，省略“主语+be”（= while they are eating...）；课堂六种省略形态：连词+形容词/名词/现在分词/过去分词/不定式/介词短语（Whenever free... / If well read... / as if to say...）| while 后三个现在分词并列：eating, chatting and making——同一时间轴上的三重伴随 | dumplings 后接 that 定语从句，will eat 一般将来时 + at the very start（very 强调“正是、恰恰”）| 春晚民俗场景的英文范本：gather around 围坐
pattern: S + V + to V, while + V-ing₁, V-ing₂ and V-ing₃ + that-定语从句
imitationCn: 他们围坐在篝火旁讲故事，一边烤着红薯、哼着歌，一边数着天上要许愿的流星。
imitationHint: They gather around the campfire to tell stories, while roasting sweet potatoes, humming songs and counting the shooting stars → that they will make wishes on
imitationAnswer: They gather around the campfire to tell stories, while roasting sweet potatoes, humming songs and counting the shooting stars that they will make wishes on.

sentence: All over the country, people are celebrating their good fortune, celebrating their family's togetherness, and celebrating their nation's strength.
translation: 全国上下，人们庆祝着自己的福气，庆祝着家人的团聚，庆祝着国家的强盛。
analysis: celebrating × 3 动词重复排比（anaphora 的谓语版）：同一分词三连，宾语从“个人福气”到“家庭团聚”再到“国家强盛”，由小及大、层层升格——演讲式抒情的顶配句式，呼应必修一 U1 的 to your family, to your community and to our country | 现在进行时 are celebrating 渲染“此时此刻举国同庆”的现场感 | All over the country 状语前置定空间基调 | fortune 课堂拓展：make a fortune 发财、seek one's fortune 闯天下、tell one's fortune 算命；togetherness 抽象名词“团聚感”
pattern: 状语, S + are + V-ing + A, V-ing + B, and V-ing + C（递升排比）
imitationCn: 整个校园里，同学们分享着自己的收获，分享着班级的荣誉，分享着母校的骄傲。
imitationHint: All over the campus, students are sharing their own gains, sharing their class's honour, → and sharing their school's pride（三重 sharing 递升）
imitationAnswer: All over the campus, students are sharing their own gains, sharing their class's honour, and sharing their school's pride.

sentence: After all, home is where all family members are together.
translation: 毕竟，家就是全家人团聚的地方。
analysis: 课件专项：where 引导表语从句——is 后的 where... 从句作表语，where 在此表抽象“地点”（家不是房子，是团聚之所在）；课堂同族：This is where I disagree. / The young man became what he wanted to be.（what 表语从句）| After all 毕竟——收尾点题的语气词，给全文情感一个落点 | 全句仅九词却是全文题眼：物理的 village/house 让位于情感的 where——定义式金句（A is where...）可直接迁移：Happiness is where the heart finds peace. | 与必修一 U2 的 The key to... is... 同为“观点定义句”家族
pattern: After all, + S + is + where + 从句（表语从句）
imitationCn: 毕竟，课堂就是思想相遇碰撞的地方。
imitationHint: After all, the classroom is where → ideas meet and collide（where 表语从句）
imitationAnswer: After all, the classroom is where ideas meet and collide.

sentence: The Dragon Boat Festival, for example, is celebrated in honour of Qu Yuan.
translation: 例如，端午节就是为纪念屈原而庆祝的。
analysis: for example 双逗号插入句中（不占句首）——举例衔接语的灵活位置，让主语先声夺人 | be celebrated in honour of：被动语态 + in honour of 为向……致敬/纪念（课堂 honour 网络：It's a great honour to do 很荣幸、feel honoured 感到荣幸、honour sb for sth 表彰）| 节日起源的万能句式：Festival + is celebrated in honour of / in memory of + 人物——文化介绍类作文（书信向外国朋友介绍中国节日）的骨架句 | 同版块考点 observe 多义：observe a tradition 遵守习俗、observe the festival 过节
pattern: N, for example, is celebrated in honour of + 人物
imitationCn: 例如，中秋节就是为庆祝团圆和丰收而设立的。
imitationHint: The Mid-Autumn Festival, for example, is celebrated → in honour of reunion and harvest（for example 插入句中）
imitationAnswer: The Mid-Autumn Festival, for example, is celebrated in honour of reunion and harvest.
